```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
length(raw$features)

fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(fire)

first_coordinate <- unlist(fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]])
first_coordinate

wildfires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)

fires <- wildfires |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )

```

```{r}
fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, "\\bAugust\\b")) |>
  nrow()

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(coordinate) coordinate[[1]]))
    ),
    lat = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) mean(map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(coordinate) coordinate[[2]]))
    )
  )
```

```{r}
largest_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    polygon_lng = map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(coordinate) coordinate[[1]])
    ),
    polygon_lat = map(
      geometry_coordinates,
      \(rings) map_dbl(rings[[1]], \(coordinate) coordinate[[2]])
    )
  )

fire_map <- leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron)

fire_map <- reduce(
  seq_len(nrow(largest_fires)),
  \(map, i) addPolygons(
    map,
    lng = largest_fires$polygon_lng[[i]],
    lat = largest_fires$polygon_lat[[i]],
    popup = paste0(
      largest_fires$incident[[i]], " (",
      largest_fires$fire_year[[i]], ") - ",
      scales::comma(largest_fires$gis_acres[[i]]), " acres"
    ),
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.5
  ),
  .init = fire_map
)

fire_map |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lng)),
    lat1 = min(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lat)),
    lng2 = max(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lng)),
    lat2 = max(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lat))
  )
```
